text:
Maya R: heads-up — holiday weekend changed and we just got a note from infra that the APAC night window (Sat 00:00-06:00 UTC) has no primary assigned. We have two enterprise Dedicated customers with traffic there. Need a volunteer to be primary for the gap.

oncall-bot: scheduled-rotation check — no primary found for eng-oncall 2026-04-04 00:00-06:00 UTC.

Liam: I can take primary for that 00:00-06:00 UTC slot, I'm PST and will be awake for it. @Sanjay would you be okay as secondary?

Sanjay: I can cover secondary. Quick q: any planned deploys or risky jobs that night? Elaine or release calendar?

Elaine: support update — there's an open low-severity escalation for cust-omega but nothing blocking. Release calendar shows no deploys scheduled for that window.

Maya R: thanks. If Liam takes primary, follow the APAC handoff runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-night-handoff|apac-night-handoff>. High-level checklist: verify prefix/KV cache health, watch burst queue and GPU memory on dedicated pools, and set the small-quant fallback policy pre-window. Runbook quick snippet below for convenience:

```bash
# quick checks
curl -sS https://infra.metrics/api/alerts | jq '.alerts[] | select(.team=="inference")'
# enable fallback policy
redwood-ctl fallback set --policy small-quant --ttl 3600
# verify cache hit rate
curl -sS https://observability/api/kv-cache | jq '.hit_rate'
```

Liam: noted. I'll set the fallback before 23:45 UTC and validate dashboards. Are there any pools we should keep an eye on?

Sanjay: watch dedicated-pool-12 — memory pressure spiked earlier this week, could regress under a burst. Monitor /var/log/inference/gpu-oom.log and the gpu_mem_usage grafana panel.

Elaine: I'll keep the support channel open and will page if customer-facing latency >2s sustained for >5min. I'll also pre-load the customer alert template if needed.

Maya R: recording assignment here — Primary: Liam, Secondary: Sanjay, Support lead: Elaine. Please add these to the rotation bot so ops knows.

oncall-rotation-bot: command received. Assigning Liam as primary and Sanjay as secondary for 2026-04-04 00:00-06:00 UTC. Please ack to confirm.

Liam: ack. I'll post a 30m-before window handoff note with final checks and config changes.

Sanjay: ack. I'll be reachable if you need a quick failover.

Elaine: ack. I'll also prep the customer comms snippet in case we need to escalate.

Maya R: great — thanks everyone. If anything changes (deploys, infra alerts, new escalations) ping here and DM the current primary immediately so we don't have a gap.
